newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat stock at 18-month high in Milan.
newsitem.headline: Fiat stock at 18-month high in Milan.

text.p: Fiat SpA continued its rally on the Milan stock exchange, boosted by good European car market data, with shares rising above 5,800 lire, a level not seen since October 1995.
"The market's punting on the possibility of Fiat keeping its market shares," one analyst said. "The basis for the rise is the car maker's performance both on the Italian and the European markets."
At 1020 GMT, Fiat was up 2.48 percent at 5,775 lire after earlier touching a high of 5,810 lire.

Data out today from Brussels showed Fiat group new registrations up 7.5 percent in March giving it a market share of 12.8 percent, up from a previous 11.6 percent, in second place behind Germany's Volkswagen.
Boosted by a government incentive scheme, Fiat saw Italian new registrations of its cars jump 22.7 percent in March.
